@about: Room air add-on (0.11 SU.1812). Words of the add-on and of lib/room.js's keys. Other languages fall back to English until the next translation run.
name: Room air
intro: Air speed, temperature and humidity in one room, from its supply and return terminals and fan coils, worked out on CadCraft's own airflow solver. A design aid: it has not yet been compared with measured room air.
host.none: This app has no rooms to read from. Type the outline below.
aid: A design aid, not a certificate: the engineer responsible for the ventilation checks the result.
room.none: No rooms found: the walls enclose none on any level. Type the outline below.
room.outline: Outline (x, y in mm, one corner per line)
room.outline.hint: Picking a room fills this from the model, with the ceiling height from the walls around it.
term.list: One per line: kind, x, y, z, width, depth, airflow (L/s), supply temperature (°C), supply humidity (%), rotation (degrees), name
term.hint: kind is supply, return, exhaust or fancoil. x, y is the face centre in plan, z its height (a ceiling terminal's z is the ceiling height). A fan coil's width and depth are its length and width, z is its underside; it blows out of its +x end and takes air in at its -x end, and one above the ceiling blows down from under its ends. Returns and exhausts need no temperature.
term.read: {n} terminals and fan coils read from the room.
term.noflow: Some have no airflow in the model (set it in the duct calculation, or type it here).
term.defaults: The supply air is not in the model: 14 °C and 90 % are filled in to start (a typical cooling setting). Type yours.
term.none: No diffusers, grilles or fan coils of BimCraft's equipment in this room. Type them below.
src.list: One per line: x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1 (a box in mm), heat (W), moisture (g/h)
src.hint: People, equipment and lights as boxes that warm the air in them. The numbers are yours: none are built in.
src.name: Source {n}
run.stopped: Stopped at {s} s: the numbers are those of that moment.
res.facts: After {s} s of air, on {cells} cells of {cell} mm ({mb} MB).
res.dt: Warmer at 1.1 m than at 0.1 m by
res.zone: In the occupied zone: from {low} to {high} mm above the floor and at least {edge} mm from the walls.
res.out: Air out (returns and exhausts, from the solution)
res.settling: Over the last {s} s the room's mean temperature moved by {d} K: run longer if that matters.
view.caption.z: Plan at {at} mm above the floor. Grey: walls, ceiling, floor and fan coils.
view.caption.x: Section at x = {at} mm. Grey: walls, ceiling, floor and fan coils.
view.caption.y: Section at y = {at} mm. Grey: walls, ceiling, floor and fan coils.
lim.turb: Turbulence is an eddy viscosity (Smagorinsky) with a floor of {nu} m²/s so a coarse grid stays steady: jets spread faster and decay sooner than real ones.
lim.walls: Walls, floor and ceiling are smooth and pass no heat; there is no radiation, no sun and no air leaking in.
lim.faces: A terminal is as big as the grid cells it covers, and a diffuser blows straight down (no four-way throw or swirl).
lim.cell: Cells are {cell} mm: anything smaller than about two cells is not resolved.
valid.waits: Not yet compared with measured room air: the comparison waits on measured velocity and temperature profiles of a published test room. Checked so far: the air, heat and water that come in leave again.
roomair.err.outline: The outline needs at least three corners.
roomair.err.height: The ceiling height must be between 1 m and 30 m.
roomair.err.kind: {name}: the kind is supply, return, exhaust or fancoil.
roomair.err.where: {name}: x, y and z must be numbers.
roomair.err.supplyair: {name}: give its supply air temperature and humidity.
roomair.err.nosupply: There is no supply terminal or fan coil in the room.
roomair.err.noreturn: There is no return, exhaust or fan coil for the air to leave by.
roomair.err.rh: The humidity at the start is a percentage from 0 to 100.
roomair.err.toobig: That grid would have {cells} cells: choose a coarser grid.
roomair.err.empty: No air cells: the outline is smaller than one cell.
roomair.err.unstable: The solution went unstable at {at} s: choose the finer grid or lower the airflow, and run again.
roomair.warn.floor: A viscosity floor of {nu} m²/s keeps this grid stable (more than the air's own).
roomair.warn.facearea: {name}: on this grid its face is {grid} m² against {face} m²; the airflow is kept, the face speed is not.
roomair.warn.noface: {name}: its face is not next to the room's air, so it was left out.
roomair.warn.where: {name}: not within 300 mm of the ceiling or the floor, so it was left out.
roomair.warn.nosource: {name}: its box holds no air cells, so it adds nothing.
roomair.warn.nozone: The room is too small for an occupied zone with these margins.
roomair.valid.waits: Not yet compared with measured room air.
roomair.valid.nosource: The measured profiles have no source, so they were not used.
